candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record supports recurrent melanoma with satellite lesions and a focally involved lymph node, consistent with Stage IIIC (T4aN3) with satellite metastases. 'Melanoma, recurrent' captures the disease entity and recurrence but lacks the mandatory staging components (IIIC, T4a, N3) and the explicit satellite metastases qualifier required by the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies melanoma recurrence but omits the required AJCC stage (IIIC), T-category (T4a), N-category (N3), and the specific satellite metastases designation

case_quality_flags: Staging inference required from clinical narrative; explicit AJCC staging not directly stated in record but strongly supported by satellite lesions and nodal involvement
Post-treatment histopathology shows complete tumor regression after T-VEC, which may complicate staging assessment at biopsy timepoint
